description: N5/C3 test-gap triage over the new qualification tests and smokes

required_behaviours_covered.instructions: The tests in this diff cover every required behaviour of the slice: binding, parameter substitution, expiry, live authority, self-approval, agent refusal, agent requester eligibility, cross-tenant and cross-branch refusal, idempotency and replay, state machine and terminal states, unknown outcomes, exception ownership, evidence-gated closure, unknown-resolution closure refusal, and activity derivation

criteria.true: Each listed behaviour has at least one explicit assertion at the domain layer, the database layer, or the HTTP layer
criteria.false: At least one required behaviour has no assertion anywhere in the diff

negative_path_quality.instructions: The negative tests assert the specific refusal code rather than merely asserting that some error occurred, so a weakened control would be caught

criteria.true: Refusal tests compare the exact error code or SQLSTATE, and positive controls confirm the same call succeeds when the condition is satisfied
criteria.false: Refusal tests only assert a non-success status or a thrown error of any kind

gap.instructions: If a reviewer added one test to this slice, which gap is most material

criteria.expiry_http: Approval expiry is asserted in the domain and the database, but not end to end over HTTP
criteria.concurrency: Concurrent duplicate submissions are not exercised
criteria.clock_boundaries: Boundary equality of the expiry instant is not exercised
criteria.unknown_retry_evidence: A definitive outcome for an unsettled attempt with evidence is not asserted end to end
criteria.exception_drift: Case and work item drift is asserted on close but not on reopen
criteria.activity_divergence: Divergent activity replay for the C3 sources is not asserted

coverage_confidence.instructions: How complete is this test set for a bounded synthetic slice
